pages.title: Computronium Tiles
pages.text: Computronium cut into tiles, each one lit by faint, shifting traces. A floor of them flickers softly, as if computing something about whoever walks across it. Patterns chase each other across the joints between tiles, too fast to follow, and settle into stillness when the room empties.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I tiled a floor with computronium offcuts. It flickers gently underfoot, and I am almost sure it is only decorative. It has never miscounted anything.
$(thing)Used in$(): Computronium Tiles Slab, Computronium Tiles Stairs.
